mission: Validate explicit positive physical artwork reviews against retained original evidence

impacts.reason: One explicit retained visual review becomes an exact proposal only after complete original-byte lineage and unique physical sibling checks. This supplies positive physical evidence without changing exact identity policy or enabling perceptual matching.

routes: Existing staging proposal resolver and exact approval checks
dependencies: Retained metered snapshots, authoritative complete physical catalogue, existing manual precedence and approval guards
impact.deployment_impact: Staging API rebuild; existing Yuyu690e and SNKR5146 delivery components remain. No manual jobs, schedules or configuration changes.

recovery.procedure: Fix forward the prior pinned staging API source if proof validation or baseline invariants fail; retain all snapshots and mapping lineage. No mapping approval occurs in delivery.
recovery.trigger: Proof accepts stale or incomplete evidence, same-art twins, a non-staging environment, or writes mapping/price state during analysis
recovery.backup: Code delivery writes no schema, mapping, candidate, price or queue data; retained prior successful API deployment and exact source supply recovery. Any later bounded approval needs separate before/after receipt.

verification.observation_window: After serialized full delivery verification, re-read candidate1 and proof originals before any guarded mapping canary, then observe its ordinary natural collector attempt. Other ambiguities and quarantines remain unresolved.
